actions.rationale: Duration-long / receive MX CRAH27 (paper alias CORRA_2027-03, family locked to CORRA/CRA). Packet mid implied_rate 3.13 / price 96.87. Long in this book is long duration with P&L inverted in implied-rate space: profits if Mar-27 implied CORRA falls from 3.13 toward the still-alive near-term path (1m Dec-2026 2.58, 3m Dec-2026 CRAZ26 2.775), not if Canada catches up to SOFR. The 2027 contract is where the unwarranted hiking cycle is concentrated; do not migrate onto SOFR, AONIA, CA-US 2Y, or USDCAD.

events.invalidation: BoC hike/endorsement of a mid-3s 2027 path, CRAH27 implied ≥3.13 and rising toward 3.365, or Canada trim/median and labor reheating from the August packet prints. Energy-only noise is not invalidation. Fail closed on options and on any unmarkable structure.
events.rationale: Single OPEN long CORRA_2027-03, $850m (85% gross). Side long = receive / duration long. No hedge. Trusted code hydrates the 3.13 mid.
events.thesis: Concentrated duration-long CORRA_2027-03: fade the 2027 BoC hiking cycle that 3m CRA prices and that 1m CORRA plus Canadian core/labor do not. Empty prior book; 85% of the $1bn gross cap in one markable rates contract; unused cash stays undeployed and earns official NY Fed SOFR ACT/360. No hedge leg.
